---
title: Block quotes
author: Test Author
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A block quote whose closing paragraph starts with an em dash has the attribution too.
    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['attribution: \[\s*Mickaël Canouil, 2026\s*\]']
---

> Design for the reader who cannot see the colours.
>
> — Mickaël Canouil, 2026
